text: Got the offer letter this morning. I read it three times in the parking lot and then called Ma before I'd even started the car.
Sunny walk to the bakery, warm bread, the cat followed me halfway down the street. Small day, good day.
Ravi and I finally fixed the leaking tap ourselves. Took two hours and one YouTube video but we did it and we were ridiculous about how proud we were.
Laughed so hard at dinner with Ines and Tomás that the waiter came over to check on us.
First swim of the summer. Cold, bright, perfect.
Grandpa remembered my name today without me telling him. He held my hand the whole visit. I'm still smiling.
The tomatoes on the balcony are actually turning red. I genuinely did not believe this would happen.
Saturday market with Aiko. We bought too many peaches and ate them on the steps of the library like kids.
My code passed review on the first try. Femi left a comment that just said 'clean'. Best word.
Woke up before the alarm feeling rested for the first time in weeks. Made pancakes. Danced badly in the kitchen.
Lena's baby was born at 4am. Both healthy. I cried at the photo and then ate cereal at my desk grinning like an idiot.
Quiz night: we came second out of twelve teams, which for us is basically winning the World Cup.
Mum sent a voice note singing happy birthday off-key. Played it four times.
Nothing special happened, honestly. I just felt light all day, like someone opened a window in my chest.
Joon-ho taught me the right way to fold dumplings and mine finally looked like dumplings instead of tiny crime scenes.
Got the bike back from the repair shop. Rode the long way home along the canal just because I could.
Snow day! Office closed. Hot chocolate, blanket, old movies with Mateo.
I'd been dreading the dentist all week and it was fine, no cavities. The relief turned into a really good mood that lasted all afternoon.
Our team won the five-a-side final. Kwame scored in the last minute and we piled on him like puppies.
Found twenty euros in last winter's coat. Bought flowers for the flat.
Dinner at Noor's. Her mother kept piling food onto my plate and calling me 'beta'. I felt like family.
The new album from my favourite band came out at midnight and it's even better than I hoped. Listened twice through on the walk to work.
Hana texted out of nowhere: 'thinking of you, remember the pier?' We haven't talked in two years. Made my whole week.
Little things today: green lights all the way, a stranger complimented my scarf, the soup turned out great.
Passed my driving test!!! Third time lucky. Dad honked the horn all the way down our street.
Beach with the kids. Zara built a 'castle' that was mostly one wall and named it after the dog. Perfect afternoon.
Not a huge feeling, just pleasant. Coffee was good, inbox was quiet, I left on time.
The landlord agreed to fix the heating AND knocked a bit off the rent for the trouble. I did a little victory lap around the living room.
Played piano for an hour without checking my phone once. Forgot how much I love this.
Wedding rehearsal for Priya and Sean. Everything went wrong in the funniest ways and nobody cared. I love these people.
My sister and I spent the whole evening going through old photos and laughing at our haircuts from the 2000s.
First day of the holidays. Slept in, read in the garden, ate strawberries. That's the whole report.
Coach Ndlovu said I can play in Saturday's match. I've been on the bench all season!
The garden centre had the exact lemon tree I wanted. Carried it home on the bus, got some funny looks, worth it.
Video call with Abuela. She showed me her new glasses and her terrible jokes have gotten worse, which I love.
Sometimes the day just clicks. Got through my list, went for a run, cooked properly. I feel really good.
Elif surprised me with tickets to the jazz club. We stayed until they turned the lights on.
Rain all day but the house smelled like cinnamon rolls and Marcus played records. Cosy and happy.
Yesterday I was a mess about the presentation. Today it went great and three people asked for my slides. What a difference a day makes.
Puppy class graduation. Biscuit did NOT sit on command but he did steal the trainer's hat and everyone clapped anyway.
Tried the climbing gym with Sofia. Fell off a lot. Laughed more than I've laughed in months.
We finally painted the bedroom. Sage green. It feels like a new home.
Results came back: Dr. Okafor says the scan is clear. I sat in the car for ten minutes just breathing and smiling.
Kids' drawing on the fridge says 'best mum in the univers'. Leaving the spelling exactly as it is forever.
Good news from Tariq: he's moving back to the city in June. My best friend, ten minutes away again.
Sat by the river after work and watched the herons. Didn't think about anything. It was lovely.
My first sourdough loaf rose! It's lopsided and dense in the middle and I am beside myself with joy.
Office birthday cake for me, organised by Gemma. I didn't think anyone knew. Felt really seen.
I keep replaying the moment Ana said yes. We're getting married. WE'RE GETTING MARRIED.
Morning run in the fog, then a long shower, then the crossword with Pete. A soft, happy Sunday.
Got a handwritten thank-you card from a student I tutored last year. She got into her first-choice university.
I was worried the reunion would be awkward. It wasn't at all. Like no time had passed. Came home buzzing.
Lunch in the sun with Daniela and Chiara, gelato after. Didn't check email for an hour and the world survived.
Fixed the wobbly table with a folded receipt. Victory.
Dad finally tried the curry I've been perfecting and asked for seconds. He never asks for seconds.
New glasses. I can see individual leaves on the trees again. I didn't know how blurry everything had become.
Kofi got the scholarship. I've been helping him with applications for months and when he called he could barely talk.
Long weekend in the hills. Woodsmoke, terrible card games, Lucía's awful singing. I want to bottle this.
Today was the first day since the breakup that I felt genuinely happy, not just fine. Noticed it on the tram and nearly laughed out loud.
Book club picked my suggestion and everyone loved it, even Harold who hates everything.
Spent the evening on the roof with Yusuf watching the meteor shower. We counted 23. He made a wish every single time.
A totally ordinary Tuesday and I feel great. No reason. I'll take it.
Took Nana to the seaside like she's been asking. She ate chips on the wall and told stories about being nineteen. Golden.
Our little choir sang at the care home. One woman sang along to every word with her eyes closed.
The plant I thought I'd killed has a new leaf. Hello, little guy.
Finished the 10k. Not fast. Didn't walk once. Jess was waiting at the end with a sign that said 'you absolute legend'.
We cooked together for once instead of eating on the sofa. Talked about everything. This is what I want more of.
Results day: 2:1. Not the first I dreamed of but I'm honestly thrilled, and Mum's been crying happy tears all afternoon.
Bumped into Old Mr. Haddad from the corner shop who used to give us free sweets. He recognised me instantly.
Picnic in the park with the whole cousin crowd. Uncle Raj brought his ancient guitar. Best afternoon of the year so far.
